Name: Pallavi Jain
Bio:
Pallavi Jain is a Founder of Plaksha University. Pallavi is also a Project Leader at Boston Consulting Group (BCG), who played a key role through a secondment in building Plaksha from scratch since its early days of conceptualization.

She has worked at BCG across education and TMT (Technology, Media and Telecom) sectors in a mix of strategy and implementation functions, including a flagship project with the Government of Haryana to transform quality of education in 15,000 schools. She also previously worked at Citibank in corporate banking.

Pallavi completed her MBA from IIM Bangalore where she was on the Director's Merit List. She holds an Economics Honors degree from St. Stephen's College, Delhi.
Education: MBA, IIM Bengaluru | BA Honors Economics, St. Stephen's College, Delhi University
